headline: Battle Lines Shift Across Contested Sectors
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the pressure mounting on a handful of fronts, with several lines changing since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, rising to 63 base events in 24 hours; its holdings now stand at one Warden, five Colonial, and three neutral bases, with six events in the latest two-hour watch. Nevish Line has reached 45 events and shifted to four Warden, four Colonial, and no neutral bases, while casualties and enlistments accelerate. Linn Mercy records 40 events, three recently, and holds two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral position; its casualty rate is sharply rising. Mooring County is no longer quiet: 25 events mark renewed movement, including three in two hours, though Wardens retain eleven of twelve bases. Marban Hollow remains divided at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base, but its 19 events are older, the last reported many hours ago. Stonecradle shows six events, all within six hours, amid heavy losses. Most other sectors report no base movement in the latest day.
